ACQUIRE THE GEOMETRY NEEDED BY THE OUTPUT TASK
31 October 2026. Ordinary proofs and a finite acquisition operation.

This is the main task-sensitive refinement of PROOF.txt. It uses a direct
retaining spectral learner, rather than first acquiring an l1 dictionary.
The geometric idea is established projection/duality reasoning. No historical
priority, architecture separation, practical sample efficiency, or general
polynomial-in-rank acquisition theorem is claimed. The new executable is
notes/quadratic_scalar_baseline.py. Its saved ledgers include unsuccessful
stages, all physical repetitions, actual return lengths and numerical checks.

1. TASK AND PHYSICAL CONTRACT

There are m unknown self-adjoint contractions T_a on one real Hilbert space.
The seed f satisfies ||f||<=1. A later task supplies any word w of length at
most H and requests the scalar <f,T_w f>, to additive error epsilon. A single
accepted model must work for every such word, including words chosen after
seeing the acquisition data. It need not identify the full hidden state,
every trajectory law, conditional rare events, or a best control word.

For actual words u,v, the learner can obtain independent or conditionally
unbiased scalar reports of <T_u f,T_v f>, with a known bounded range. A known
digitization or calibration bias can be reserved separately. These reports
are acquired by actual physical experiments. Neither synthetic hidden-state
preparation nor a normalized vector-query oracle is present.

A sufficient realization is a finite menu of reversible Markov kernels with
the SAME stationary distribution pi, stationary preparation, and bounded
observable f. Each primitive is self-adjoint and contractive in L2(pi).
A chronological return word realizes the inner product with |u|+|v| actual
primitives and two endpoint readings. All preparations and primitives are
paid even when the resulting report is deterministic. The finite-state
fixture has f in {-1,+1}, so every report has magnitude one.
With the code convention T_w f=T_(last)...T_(first)f, a chronological
Markov experiment executing u followed by reverse(v) has the required mean.

controls do not automatically have one common contractive Hilbert norm.

## Verdict

The norm-based Schur yield, constructive finite rational alternatives, and qualified epsilon^(-2) acquisition claim are sound. Three small wording corrections were communicated to root: distinguish an actual coefficient norm from an arbitrary certified upper bound; initialize general matrix-norm bisection with a genuinely valid spectral-norm upper bound; and distinguish selected matrix-entry bit sizes from the longer final error-bound fractions.

The new warm H8-to-H64 artifact supplies the operational continuation that the original independent-run records did not demonstrate. A dated addendum has also been appended to the earlier implementation audit.

## 1. Norm-based Schur yield: the 25z bound is valid

Under exact invariance, empirical least-squares minimality gives

    lambda_max(Rhat) <= (1+sqrt(3))^2 z < 7.465z,

when t<=1/2. The true residual at the empirical coefficient C is positive semidefinite, and the acquired perturbation bound gives

    lambda_min(Rhat) >= -z(1+||C||)^2.

Furthermore,

    ||C|| <= ||B0^(-1)|| ||Atilde||

because nu+z=t<=1/2. Thus the negative eigenvalues have magnitude at most 25z, and

    ||Rhat|| <= 25z.

# Independent audit of the implemented quadratic scalar learner

31 October 2026. Reviewed quadratic_scalar_baseline.py, the called source and shot-schedule code, the rational norm/contraction helpers, and both saved H=8 and H=64 results. No acquisition experiment was repeated. The only executed check reconstructed the existing physical bills from saved raw batch records.

## Verdict

No model-soundness error was found in either recorded successful run. The implementation follows the rational-whitener/Schur theorem, including the true-subspace gauge, the two leakage directions supplied by actual self-adjointness, stored contraction/seed errors, and binary64 execution allowance.

The substantive presentation qualification is that the confidence ledger proves joint soundness with possible rejection, not automatically conditional accuracy given a successful return. A bit-length metadata label was also corrected in coordination with the spectral-baseline agent; numerical results were not changed.

## 1. Pool and successor indexing

The pool starts with the actual landmarks in their existing order and appends each distinct one-step successor. The empty seed remains the first landmark. Therefore the seed coordinate is consistently e_0.

For primitive a, the code uses

    Khat_a = sym(Gram[W, W+a]),
    Dhat_a = Gram[W+a, W+a].

The successor map w -> wa is injective on distinct literal words, so both selections have operator norm one. The acquired full-pool operator-norm Gram error eta therefore also bounds the G, K, and D submatrix errors. Symmetrization preserves the error bound because the true K is symmetric under the supplied self-adjointness premise.

D_a is the Gram of the actual successor vectors. Thus D_a=V*T_a*T_aV, which equals V*T_a^2V here. The interpretation as both forward and reverse leakage is justified by actual self-adjoint primitives, not by the numerical symmetry imposed on the fitted matrices.

    z = eta ||R||^2,
    t=nu+z <= 1/2.
